name: Chai Cup
summary: A cosy download button whose arrow drops into a cup that fills with tea as the file loads
about: Chai Cup is a warm brown download button. Its arrow pulls back, drops in with a splash and turns into a teacup that springs up around it. A thin stream pours, bubbles rise and the tea climbs with the progress while the cup gently rocks. When it is full, steam curls up, golden sparkles pop and the label says Downloaded. A friendly fit for menus, PDFs and music.
how: Hover to tilt the cup; press Download.
The box squashes, the arrow drops in with a little splash and a cup springs up in its place.
Tea pours in and rises with the download while the label counts the percent and megabytes.
When full, steam rises, sparkles pop and the label says Downloaded; then the tea drains and the arrow springs back.
